contrast: Same initial weights, four task-draws/update, donor data, seed, purged episode labels, sampled 32 query examples, query residual MSE, Adam outer optimization, clipping and update count. Only the training objective changes: evaluate that query MSE at zero or after five support SGD steps.
device: CPU for both arms, one thread per concurrent seed
donor_batches: Reconstruct archived donor episode and minibatch RNG streams. Validate every label-set hash and archived RNG state. Evaluate the untouched query objective after either zero or five support steps.
evaluation: All frozen original 2024/2025 target masks and horizon labels. Fit target SGD on the frozen local support, same batches and schedule between objectives, no target selection. Compare seed/city/budget/horizon means at zero, .01x3, .03x5 and .03x10. Report all schedules.
evaluation_donor_measure: Seven common 2023 label dates per donor, selected by the released checkpoint investigation hash rule; descriptive training-retention measure only, not held-out donor evidence.
hypothesis: An objective penalizing forecasts after local updates can yield a worse zero-step initialization than directly minimizing zero-step query errors.
interpretation: Isolates the after-update objective within the original episodic data distribution. Original pooled training uses a different sampling and optimization recipe; comparisons with it do not isolate the objective.
stage: post hoc on previously inspected target years; no target selection
support_sgd: Rate .03, five steps, 32 sampled rows/step, grad norm clip 1.
